chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, raised it regarding
clipping the nails, begin with the little finger of the left hand, then end with the right hand.

key_terms.خِنْصِرِ الْأَيْسَرِ: the little finger of the left hand

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended order for clipping fingernails according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This brief narration from al-Kafi specifies the precise order for clipping nails, beginning with the little finger of the left hand and concluding with the right, reflecting the Shia emphasis on meticulous adherence to the Prophet's and Imams' practices (Sunnah) in daily hygiene. This specific sequence is often interpreted by jurists as a manifestation of *adab* (etiquette) and *taharah* (purity), aligning physical grooming with spiritual discipline. The ruling underscores the importance of following prescribed methods in acts of worship and daily life, a hallmark of Ja'fari fiqh.
